deliverables: WP1 – Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet and API ecosystem layer
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Milestone-based disbursement through TRSC and PSSC tooling
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the vendor Wirex
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for "Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex" to deliver open-source payments infrastructure connecting Cardano to on-chain settlement, banking rails, stablecoin systems, wallet interfaces, and Visa card issuance.

claims.claim: The proposal says Cardano lacks seamless infrastructure for everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity at scale.
The proposal will deliver full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for on-chain settlement through smart contracts connected to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
A core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to on-chain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, over $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.
The proposal claims the work will increase Cardano utility, transaction volume, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity on-chain.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting and audit references.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.
Audit, oversight, administration, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.
Treasury funds will be managed through Sundae Labs treasury smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based multisig approvals, external oversight entities, and a public dashboard.

summary: The anchor requests 3,961,538 ada for an Intersect-administered Wirex payments project, with high-level deliverables and governance controls stated, several external references for process and smart-contract oversight, and major adoption/economic impact claims largely asserted rather than evidenced inside the document.
